title: Production Compose AI security and payment reviews
description: The optional ai-security Compose profile runs the shared General Security Review and Payment Risk Review controller with a dedicated TLS engine. Matching Strix controller and sandbox images are published for AMD64 and ARM64, with standalone installation instructions. No host Python or development bridge is required; provider credentials stay in Preflyt and reviews remain source-only beta suggestions.
upgrade: Choose a newly published release containing both Strix images, apply normal application migrations, set COMPOSE_PROFILES=ai-security, pull and recreate services. Preserve Strix state/connection volumes and use matching controller, sandbox, API and worker versions. The optional profile needs additional host resources and a privileged dedicated nested Docker engine; it never mounts the host Docker socket. See docs/operations/strix-production-compose.md. Image publication does not restart existing servers.
